# Frontend calls against cursor states

Each cell is what the call returned in a fresh session whose cursor was brought to the state by the public Python API (`scripts/diagrams/refusals.py`). `ok` is accepted; `ok, cancel` is accepted and the driver must cancel the effect in flight; anything else is the typed exception.
